roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare for new enemies at each dialogue and handoff, especially the final return to Wong Li.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The forest keeper's handoff reveals Wong Li, whose dialogue creates the bathhouse trigger.
Crossing that trigger brings Nethran and two goblin laborers.
Return the clue to unlock the librarian, then question the librarian to spawn the scroll thief and three underlings.
The final handoff makes Wong Li attackable.

notes: Approval E320. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
